answer: Promotion out of probation requires 20 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. Because the wander record is per identity, the zephyr audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, as every alias restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's kernel standing. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
